info.name: sudsygo API v1
info.description:
Postman collection for the SudsyGo backend.
Variables:
- rootUrl: server root, used by Stripe webhook because it is mounted outside /api/v1
- baseUrl: API base URL, normally {{rootUrl}}/api/v1
- token_customer, token_driver, token_admin, token_superadmin: role access tokens
- Fill placeholder IDs before testing entity-specific APIs.
